crossRefs.note: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge…
Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,
Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow…
I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way…
For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer…

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
translations.bsb: Therefore I exult in Christ Jesus in my service to God.
translations.kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
translations.asv: I have therefore my glorifying in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
